QF.id: XXVA Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards_4

question.text: The requirement that research analysts maintain confidentiality of the report till it is made public means:

answer.text: Only the final version needs to be confidential; drafts can be shared freely
The report content, recommendations, and conclusions must not be disclosed to anyone outside authorized personnel until official publication
Confidentiality applies only to the recommendation, not to the underlying analysis
The report can be shared with the entity's top 5 clients a day before public release

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook requires research analysts to maintain confidentiality of the research report until it is made public and not to make reports selectively available in advance to internal trading personnel or particular clients. The Trap: Pre-release sharing with selected clients, even top clients, violates the confidentiality and fair-distribution requirement. Limiting confidentiality only to the recommendation also misreads the rule, which covers the report. Note: The explanation stays within the source-supported rule: keep the research report confidential until public and do not selectively provide it in advance.
